vintage.installations: Publicly listed cantonments, air force stations and naval bases

rule: Cantonments, air force stations and naval bases that are openly listed by name and location. No personnel or budget figures: those are not published by site.

rules.tier: Air force stations, naval bases and cantonments are shown as major sites; other army stations as bases.
rules.installations: Only openly published locations. Cantonment coordinates are the linked town's position, not a surveyed boundary.

caveats: Positions are town-level for cantonments and naval bases.
